svg.title: Lama Zbedat, co-founder and CPO of Darb
svg.desc: Lama Zbedat, co-founder and CPO of Darb, embroidered in pink thread next to an embroidery hoop with three stitched flowers. She designs and builds the part of a product people touch, and every business gets its own experience, never a template.
svg.text: I design and build the parts of a product people touch.
Every business I work with gets its own experience, made for it from
